ammonia.reason: Short 2-week age, minimal amino acid deamination, negligible NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Clean make, very low p-cresol/indole/skatole, only faint raw-milk farm note.

bitter.reason: Limited accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides in young rennet curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No P. roqueforti, no C7/C9 methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone.

browning.reason: Maillard of residual lactose/galactose with lysine gives quesadilla browning.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism to diacetyl/acetoin in young high-fat curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipase lipolysis, low free butyric/caproic acids at short age.

creaminess.reason: 32.4% fat coats palate, young hydrated casein gives smooth mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Young elastic rennet gel, not crystalline long-aged, fractures little.

firmness.reason: Pressed 38.7% moisture semi-hard curd with pH 5.21 calcium-crosslinked casein.

fruity.reason: Minimal esterase activity, trace ethyl butanoate/hexanoate only.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat, no elevated capric/caprylic or branched goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Early proteolysis and low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine.

melt.reason: pH 5.21 demineralized casein plus 38.7% moisture allows excellent flow.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat coalescence on heating from 32.4% fat, less than aged cheddar.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Starter lactic acid to pH 5.21 with trace acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata, no hot-water kneading, flows rather than fibrous pull.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Light curd scald, minimal whey protein denaturation, trace H2S/methional.

sweet.reason: Residual galactose plus milkfat lactones delta-decalactone/dodecalactone.

umami.reason: Early rennet/plasmin proteolysis releases glutamate, low aged depth.
